events.description: Millennium threat: concern that al-Qa'ida cells worldwide had orders to attack in December; confirmed evidence of attack planning against targets in or near Jordan.
Current threat period: no confirmation that an attack is imminent, but escalating and independent indicators of attack.
Millennium threat: concern that al-Qa'ida cells worldwide had orders to attack around December's peak, with evidence of planning against targets in or near Jordan.
Current threat: escalating, independent indicators of an attack, though no confirmation that an attack is imminent.
Strategy slide on engaging Massoud amid a Taliban offensive.

key_claims: In the millennium threat, CIA assessed al-Qa'ida cells worldwide had orders to attack in December.
CIA had confirmed evidence of attack planning against targets in or near Jordan.
As of July 2000, attack was not confirmed as imminent but there were escalating, independent indicators of attack.
The strategy slide proposes engaging Masood against the Taliban and UBL (OCR garbled).
